user.title: Connect to WMATA
user.description: Pick what you want to add. You'll need a free WMATA API key from {api_key_url}. After the first entry, you can reuse the key you already saved.

location.title: Choose your station
location.description: Pick your station by name. Transfer stations include every platform and line.

bus_stop.title: Find your bus stop
bus_stop.description: If you know the stop ID, type it in. It's the seven-digit number on the sign at the stop, and {bus_stop_url} shows it too. Otherwise leave it empty, move the pin to where you catch the bus, and submit to see the stops around it.

data.near: Or find stops near this spot

data_description.near: The pin's location is sent to WMATA to look up nearby stops. It isn't stored.

nearby_stop.title: Pick your stop
nearby_stop.description: The {count} closest stops, nearest first. Stops on opposite sides of a street often share a name, so check the routes, or match the number against the sign.

commute.title: Set up your commute
commute.description: Pick the two stations you travel between. You'll get sensors for the trip in each direction: how long it takes right now, when the next train you'd take leaves, and when you'd arrive.

data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names.

reconfigure.title: Update API key
reconfigure.description: Other WMATA entries that share this key are updated too.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to WMATA
reauth_confirm.description: WMATA rejected the saved key. Enter a working one; other entries that share it are updated too.

error.invalid_auth: WMATA rejected that key. Check that it's copied correctly and that your developer subscription is active.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach WMATA. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid_location: WMATA doesn't recognize that. Stop IDs are seven digits.
error.no_stops_nearby: There are no bus stops within half a mile of that spot that you haven't already added. Move the pin, or enter the stop ID.
error.no_route: No route was found between those stations.

abort.already_configured: That station, stop, commute or map is already set up.
abort.credential_unavailable: That saved key is no longer available. Start setup again.

create_entry.default: Added. To see it on a dashboard, edit the dashboard, choose Add card, and search for WMATA. If the cards aren't listed yet, reload the browser tab.

data.transfer_buffer: Minutes to allow for changing platforms (1–30)

add_journey.title: Add a custom arrival filter
add_journey.description: Leave a field empty to match everything. A train's destination is where it terminates, not a stop along the way. Direction is the way the train is heading as it leaves this station, so trains with an unknown direction never match a direction filter. Filters reuse the station's existing polling and don't make extra requests.

journey.title: Edit arrival filter
journey.description: Leave a field empty to match everything. A train's destination is where it terminates, not a stop along the way. Direction is the way the train is heading as it leaves this station, so trains with an unknown direction never match a direction filter. Filters reuse the station's existing polling and don't make extra requests.

edit_journey.title: Which one do you want to edit?

remove_journey.title: Which one do you want to remove?
remove_journey.description: This removes its sensor. The station's arrival board stays as it is.

add_trip.title: Where would you like to go?
add_trip.description: Leaving from {origin}. Pick where you're going and you'll see the suggested route before anything is saved.

edit_trip.title: Edit station-to-station journey
edit_trip.description: Leaving from {origin}. Pick where you're going and you'll see the suggested route before anything is saved.

trip_confirm.title: Review your journey

error.duplicate_name: This station already has a journey with that name.
error.no_route: No route was found to that station. Pick a different one.

abort.no_journeys: This station doesn't have any journeys or filters yet. Add one from the previous menu.
abort.journey_not_found: That journey no longer exists. Close this dialog and open Configure again.
abort.rail_only: Station-to-station journeys are only available for rail stations.
